adjudication.notes: Local access is necessary but is not the privilege-escalation result unless the timing race also succeeds.

collector.command: read sealed passive snapshot and/or fetch upstream source control

evidence-points: no privilege change in this observation

payload.excerpt: ege management mechanism in the Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect™ app on Windows devices allows a locally authenticated non-administrative Windows user to escalate their privileges to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM. However, execution requires that the local user can also successfully exploit a race condition, which makes this vulnerability difficult to exploit.
